_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Keyboard shortcuts: on a Mac, Command shortcuts still reach Shelley from the terminal. navigator.platform is "MacIntel", and terminals render with xterm. The browser is a 1280x900 desktop window. "Press K on X" means: focus X with an eval calling X.focus(), then press K (for example "Control+Shift+D" is the key "D" with modifiers Control+Shift, and "Control+Backquote" is the key "`" with modifier Control). "The message input" is data-testid "message-input"; "the terminal input" is the element with role "textbox" and accessible name exactly "Terminal input" that is visible; "focused" means it is document.activeElement. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{ID}} and wait for the message input to be enabled. 2. Press Control+Backquote on the message input: the terminal input should be focused. 3. Press Meta+k on the terminal input: ".command-palette-input" should be focused. 4. Press Meta+k on the palette input: there should be no ".command-palette-input" (count 0). 5. Press Meta+Shift+D on the terminal input (the key "D" with modifiers Meta+Shift): ".diff-viewer-overlay" should be visible. 6. Focus the message input and press Escape: there should be no ".diff-viewer-overlay" (count 0).
